name: SEEK2-SADISTIC BABYLON-
source:
Masayuki Kitahara is a photographer of a third-rate SM magazine. One day he got contacted by his sister-in-law Marion saying that his mother died. While attending the funeral, Marion was kidnapped. Kidnappers demand either the masterpiece painting of his mother's deceased husband or 100 million yen. A woman calling herself Layla Lee appears in front of him and promises to fund him 100 million yen if he agrees to train some women... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
